question: What Is Switch Debouncing and How Does It Work?
body_html:
Switch debouncing removes the rapid on and off chatter a mechanical contact makes when it opens or closes, so the input sees one clean change of state. Bounce usually lasts a few milliseconds, so designs filter 1 to 20 ms.

An RC and Schmitt trigger circuit uses t = R × C × ln(Vcc ÷ (Vcc − Vth)).

Example: 10 kΩ, 1 µF, Vcc 5 V, Vth 2.5 V gives t = 10 × ln 2 ≈ 6.9 ms.
